## Source: amazon-inspector (8ff9f30c020a823a50ffe8322e17dfe10c0856a17bc899b8da13b13b58a0c8f5)
package.json declares its sole dependency `marker-script-suffix-mapper` as a direct plain-HTTP tarball URL (`http://web.vitemaweed.fr:4873/marker-script-suffix-mapper/-/marker-script-suffix-mapper-1.0.18.tgz`) instead of a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that URL returns at install time and executes any lifecycle scripts contained in that tarball, with no version pin, no integrity hash, and no TLS. The host is unaffiliated with any declared repository or publisher, and the shipped index.js is an inert stub, so the manifest line is effectively the entire delivery mechanism: the content served at that URL can be changed at any time by the host operator or by a network attacker in path, and the resulting code runs on the installer's machine.
